name: Nano Spray Wax

features.text: Ideal for fast and easy new car delivery.
Can be used on glass, wheels and vinyl graphics.

description: A liquid protectant that creates a durable, high-gloss finish on painted and chrome surfaces. This spray utilizes nanotechnology, hydrophobic polymers and natural wax particles to create a deep, even streak-free finish. Nano Spray Wax is easy to apply, just spray it on and wipe .
application: Surface should be clean and dry before application. 1. Mist Spray Wax sparingly on a 2’x2’ section of paint, glass or chrome. 2. Wipe and polish surface with clean microfiber towel. Buff to a glossy, streak-free finish. 3. Repeat application in sections until entire surface is treated.
review: Spelling corrected from the old sheet: streakfree -> streak-free
